column1: # REST -- `rest(t, ...c?)` (G12 phase 12, ADR-058): each member of the
# settled container that no applying cover evaluates must be admitted by
# the trial schema t, `nil` admitting none. A cover is a record of trial
# schemas: `if` over the whole container, `keys` over a member's key (a
# list member's is its index, as a string) and `members` over the member.
# A cover applies when its `if` admits the container, and evaluates a
# member its `keys` or `members` admits. Every trial sits at the atom's
# path. The check runs at generation, and a scalar has no members.
# Every expectation is both engines' agreed answer.
# Canon: covers sorted by canon and written once; a conflicting trial is nil.

column3: a: rest(nil, {if: {k: string}, keys: any, members: number})

column1: # The check: a member no cover evaluates is tried by t.
# A cover applies when its `if` admits the settled container.

column3: a: rest(nil, {if: {a: 1}, keys: any}) & {a: 1, z: true}

column1: # A list member's key is its index.
# Only an emitted member is checked: an absent optional or hidden one is not.
# Every trial of a cover sits at the atom's path, in a spread at each instance's.
# An atom still waiting on its arguments keeps its check when it meets a

column3: a: nof(1, {a: any}) & rest(nil, {if: {x: key()}, keys: any}) & {a: 1}
